messages:
maria: FYI opened a docs PR to extend the Troubleshooting -> Error reference with a short 'context limits' workflow and a fallback example when you hit token ceilings. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1429 :memo:
kevin: nice — can you include both JS + Python SDK snippets? customers keep asking for a tiny retry template they can paste. :thumbsup:
maria: yep doing both. here's the minimal python pattern I added to the PR for exponential backoff + 429 handling:
```python
for attempt in range(3):
    try:
        resp = client.generate(prompt)
        break
    except TooManyRequestsError as e:
        backoff = 0.5 * (2 ** attempt)
        time.sleep(backoff)
        continue
# fallback: if still failing, call embeddings route or truncate context
```
sam: can we also show a short example for trimming context before retry? e.g. drop oldest messages, not just brute trim. small pseudocode would help UX folks.
maria: good call — added a tiny algorithm note: 'drop whole messages until token budget fits; prefer removing system/user older than last N turns' in the prose.
olga: found two dead links in the error-ref cross-refs (the CLI troubleshooting guide and the SDK retry-policy page). I can PR a link patch once you land the snippet. pinging @docs-ci to run the link checker after CI run.
docs-ci: link-checker started for branch docs/err-ref-context-fallbacks (build #5842). Report will post here when finished. :gear:
kevin: one more ask — add a short line about partial-output semantics (if you truncate you may get partial replies; recommend function-calling/schema checks before accepting). saves escalations later.
maria: added a 2-sentence caveat and a one-liner snippet showing function-call guard. I also included a short note about choosing to fall back to embeddings+search rather than an LLM call for high-throughput clients.
olga: SGTM. I'll queue the link-fix PR and run the linter locally then merge after docs-ci green. thanks all. :sparkles:
docs-ci: link-checker finished: 3 warnings, 0 failures. Warnings: long URL length (docs team may want to alias).
maria: merging now, will follow up with a short changelog blurb for the release notes.
